strings.ui.c4p2.halves.legend.lines: Form lines – a hook at the cut edge
strings.ui.c4p2.halves.wrong_sideways: The writing runs sideways. No teeth will mesh like this.
strings.ui.c4p2.halves.tip_mouse: Drag the German half with the mouse. Mouse wheel or right-click rotates it.
strings.ui.c4p2.halves.tip_pad: D-pad slides, RB/LB rotate, A fits, X puts the half back on the book, Y undoes the last move.
strings.ui.c4p2.halves.photos: Ekdahl takes two photographs. By half past seven the Russian half must be back in Lev’s box.
strings.ui.c4p2.halves.controls: Arrow keys or WASD slide the German half one square, R rotates it (Shift+R back), Backspace undoes the last move, Enter fits.
strings.ui.c4p2.halves.board_tip: Drag half · mouse wheel or right-click rotates
strings.ui.c4p2.house.place.ws: Basement under the rear building, behind the cellar
strings.ui.c4p2.house.window.vd: Dark. Crates, a pram with no wheels, a three-legged chair.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.window.v3: Light. Lenz sits over his books; the radio plays soft dance music.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.window.v2: Dark. Frau Grabowski sits in her coat by the cold stove.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.window.v1: A night light. Herr Schulz walks up and down with the baby.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.window.ve: The lamp in the vault is lit. Kuhnert waits for the gentlemen with his cap and his box.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.window.sd: Sheets on the lines, frozen stiff. The loft door is only pushed to.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.window.s3: Light. Ilse sits at the kitchen table in her coat, drawing a house with bright windows.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.window.s2: A faint light behind the net curtain – and the curtain moves.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.window.s1: Light. The Mertens are still at supper; the conductor’s jacket hangs on its hook.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.window.se: Light. Frau Kuhnert sits at the window, the radio playing beside her.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.window.sk: Dark. A sledge against the wall, sacks of potatoes.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.window.hd: Sheets on the lines, a skylight full of snow.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.window.h3: Dark. Newspaper behind the glass, a seal on the door.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.window.h2: Dark. The bed is empty – Brettschneider is on night shift at the gasworks.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.window.h1: Light. The Kühns are playing cards; the cat sits on the windowsill.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.window.he: A bare bulb above the cellar stairs.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.window.hk: Dark. Preserves on the shelf, an old pram. At the back, the low door to Pietsch’s workshop stands ajar.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.window.ws: The basement workshop: lasts and shoes with their tickets on the shelf, embers still in the stove, the apron on its nail.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.legend.eye: Spyhole: whoever passes here is reported.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.legend.lamp: Lamp at the lodge window: she sees every step on the stairs.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.legend.hat: Cap: the block warden waits in the archway.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.state_start: Ilse is waiting in Hanna’s flat.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.wrong: This way, Ilse won’t get through the house unseen.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.error: The test walk isn’t possible right now: {error}
strings.ui.c4p2.house.tip_mouse: Click a neighbouring room to extend the route, or hold the mouse button and drag through the house. Clicking the route shortens it to that point; right-click takes back one step.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.tip_pad: D-pad leads Ilse, A or Y test walk, B one step back, X card index, LB lights, RB restart.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.controls: Arrow keys or WASD lead Ilse into the next room – over stairs, loft and cellar passage. Backspace takes back one step, R starts again, K shows Kuhnert’s card index, L the lights at 22:40, Enter starts the test walk.
strings.ui.c4p2.house.board_tip: Click: extend the route or shorten it to there · right-click: one step back
